why: State cycle 1 (docs/v3/cycles/state-1.md, P1 state-1.3): in a FilterSet multi pill, picking Failed writes `?status=["failed"]` and the table filters. Escape closes the list. A second Escape, the one a user presses to close the popover, unsets `status` from the URL and the table. Base UI's combobox clears its value on Escape when the list is closed, and the multi renderer passes that through as a write. A filter the user applied and saw applied is dropped by a close key.
what: Escape never clears a multi filter.
must_not_touch: packages/basalt-ui/src/ui/combobox.tsx unless the primitive's own contract says Escape clears
change: In the multi renderer, Escape closes the list and then the popover and writes nothing; the explicit Clear and `Reset all` stay the ways to unset. Check whether the single-select and the range renderers share the behaviour and fix them in the same commit if they do. A test opens a multi pill, picks an option, presses Escape twice and expects the handle to keep the pick and the popover to be closed.
acceptance: Pick, Escape, Escape in a multi pill keeps the pick in the store and closes the popover (test)
Clear still unsets the field (existing or new test)
out_of_scope: The pill's look; the combobox primitive's behaviour outside a filter.
